citation: Saunders B et al. Beta-alanine supplementation to improve exercise capacity and performance: a systematic review and meta-analysis. Br J Sports Med 2017;51(8):658-669
design: 3-level meta-analysis of double-blind placebo-controlled parallel RCTs
outcome_measure: Exercise capacity/performance (mostly cycling/running/rowing)
result_effect_uncertainty: Overall ES 0.18 (95% CI 0.08-0.28); duration moderated effect (p=0.004); 0.5-10 min capacity ES 0.50 (0.25-0.75) vs performance 0.11 (-0.20 to 0.42); training status not a moderator; +bicarbonate ES 0.43 (0.22-0.64)
limitations_coi: Few lifting outcomes; lead author disclosed past NAI scholarship and NAI-donated supplements (SECONDARY, author blog) - BJSM COI text not read
verification: PubMed abstract; Crossref DOI resolves (2026-11-15); PubMed record checked, no retraction/erratum
